basic_info.description:
Experience elevated coastal living just steps from iconic Ocean Beach. This exquisitely updated 2-bedroom, 2-bath residence in the coveted Outer Sunset district offers the perfect blend of modern elegance and relaxed seaside charm.
Meticulously enhanced, the home features a brand-new roof, freshly painted interior and exterior, sleek modern flooring, and designer lighting fixtures that highlight its refined aesthetic. The flexible layout includes an additional office space downstairs ideal for remote work, creative pursuits, or guest accommodations.
Situated on an expansive 2,500 Sqft lot, the property boasts a generously sized backyard, perfect for al fresco entertaining, peaceful mornings, or your dream garden retreat.
Located in a friendly and welcoming neighborhood, this home also offers unparalleled convenience. Enjoy close proximity to the San Francisco Zoo, popular local coffee shops, and a variety of dining options. Excellent public transit access makes commuting a breeze, whether you're heading downtown or exploring the vibrant Westside.
From the gentle ocean breeze to the thoughtfully curated upgrades, every detail of this home is designed to offer both luxury and comfort in one of San Franciscos most beloved coastal neighborhoods.
